message.reasoning:
Key issues: mission concept lacks explicit requirements/objectives, users somewhat identified. Technical error: "geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km" — geostationary is ~35,786 km; 600 km is LEO. Also geostationary can't give high-resolution imaging of reef. Software: STK selected (R3 met). Plan: Gantt chart present, sources listed (URLs). Preliminary progress: STK tutorials, research — minor. Presentation: reasonably structured, references cited with footnotes but no reference list matching; short (~2-3 pages ok). No contingency in plan.

Marks: C1: Adequate 5-6. Users identified (marine/conservation scientists), needs explained, but no formal requirements/objectives. Give 5.
C2: Adequate 5 — Gantt chart detailed, but no contingencies; plan fits mission somewhat. Give 5.
C3: Adequate 4-5 — tutorials done, research; no technical results. Give 4.
C4: Adequate 6 — clear structure, good writing, references cited but no reference list; footnotes URLs. Give 6.
